text: 创业板指、科创50均跌超4%，沪指跌1.78%，深成指跌3.34%，算力硬件、半导体芯片、机器人等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超5000只。
text_en: ChiNext and STAR 50 both fell over 4%, Shanghai Composite down 1.78%, Shenzhen Component down 3.34%, with computing hardware, semiconductor chips, robotics, etc. leading declines; over 5,000 stocks fell across Shanghai-Shenzhen-Beijing.
